plugin.name: Aardwolf Tick Timer
plugin.author: Fixture Author
plugin.purpose: Display time since the last Aardwolf tick

muclient.script:
local GMCP_HANDLER = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" local seconds_since_tick = 0
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if id == GMCP_HANDLER and text == "comm.tick" then seconds_since_tick = 0 end end
function update_tick_timer() seconds_since_tick = seconds_since_tick + 1 WindowShow("tick_timer", true) end
function OnPluginDisable() WindowDelete("tick_timer") end
